summary: The KG layer is real, tested (39 KG-related unit tests pass), and unusually disciplined for its size: a legacy SQLite store (nodes/edges/chunks/vector_embeddings) with an atomic, version-gated dual-write projection into normalized v2 tables, an append-only ingestion_provenance table, a genuine local export/import/backup service, and pluggable embedding providers that honestly report fallback. However, the "KG v2 normalized schema" is largely schema theater today — reads go through kgv2_* views that reconstruct the legacy free-string types byte-for-byte, and the v2 columns that would make it a Digital Brain (embedding, owner_id, visibility, importance_score, evidence, created_by) are never populated with real values. Provenance only covers the new IngestionPipeline paths (browser/web/text); chat messages, document uploads, MCP messages, and workspace events still write to the graph directly with no provenance rows, and there is no memory-type model (episodic/semantic/decisions/context) at all — the default search stack is LIKE-based keyword plus brute-force cosine over hash embeddings.
strengths: Dual-write v2 projection is engineered carefully: atomic version-gated migration (knowledge_graph.py _init_v2_schema, lines 1018-1056), legacy tables stay authoritative and untouchable, _v2_sync_report() (lines 1206-1233) is a runtime guard for write-path drift, and tests/unit/test_kg_v2_read_equivalence.py proves read equivalence.

ingestion_provenance table (knowledge_graph.py lines 949-985) is a well-designed audit trail: source_type/source_uri/content_hash/pipeline/owner/workspace_id/captured_at/embedded/linked/duplicate/agent_used/permissions, with indexes and get/list/stats APIs.

Unified SOURCE-node pattern: every pipeline-ingested content node gets an idempotent SOURCE node linked via indexed_from (knowledge_graph.py _attach_source_node, lines 2940-2977), so origin is queryable in-graph, not just in a side table.

KGPortabilityService (latticeai/services/kg_portability.py) delivers the local-first ownership promise: lossless JSON export/import (re-embeds on import), sha256-verified ZIP backup/restore including blobs and WAL/SHM cleanup.

Embedding provider abstraction (latticeai/core/embedding_providers.py) is honest: stable (model_id, dim) index identity, L2-normalized contract, hash fallback explicitly graded "fallback" and surfaced as such in embeddings_status — nothing silently faked.

NodeType/EdgeType taxonomy (kg_schema.py) is a lossless superset: legacy free strings and Korean verb edges map explicitly via _LEGACY_NODE_MAP/_LEGACY_EDGE_MAP with originals preserved in legacy_type — no information destroyed.
Content-hash idempotency on both file (sha256 of bytes, ingest_document) and text (ingest_source line 3006) paths, with duplicate detection reported through the pipeline.

graph_curator.py contains genuinely good ideas executed cleanly: secret-pattern masking before graph writes, Korean josa stripping, source-diversity scoring, alias clustering, promotion thresholds, importance decay — pure functions, no heavy deps.
Hybrid search fusion (latticeai/services/search_service.py) properly composes keyword/vector/graph channels with weights, per-source score attribution, and graph_context explanations on each match.

problems.title: KG v2 normalized tables are write-only schema theater — read path reconstructs legacy strings, rich columns never populated
problems.detail: Reads nominally use v2 (_read_from_v2 defaults on via LATTICEAI_KG_READ_V2, knowledge_graph.py:38,825) but the kgv2_* views do COALESCE(legacy_type, type) (lines 1001-1015), so every query still operates on the legacy free-string taxonomy ('Topic', 'Document', '포함함'); the normalized NodeType/EdgeType column is never used in any query, filter, or API. Worse, the columns that justify v2's existence are dead: _v2_project_node always writes owner_id=NULL, visibility='private', importance_score=0.0 and never writes embedding/style/tone/last_used (lines 1137-1151); _v2_project_edge always writes evidence='[]' and created_by='legacy' (line 1171). The schema advertises evidence-bearing, confidence-scored, ownable, embeddable entities — none of that data exists. v2 is currently a byte-faithful mirror of legacy with extra empty columns.

problems.title: Provenance coverage is partial despite 'uniform provenance' claim — chat, uploads, MCP, and workspace events bypass the IngestionPipeline
problems.detail: record_provenance is called from exactly one place: IngestionPipeline.ingest (latticeai/services/ingestion.py:177). But document uploads call knowledge_graph.ingest_document directly (latticeai/services/upload_service.py:74), chat messages call ingest_message directly (latticeai/server_app.py:671), MCP messages call ingest_message (latticeai/api/mcp.py:360), and workspace events call ingest_event in five places (latticeai/core/workspace_os.py:1195,1333,1403,1447,1705; latticeai/api/chat.py:291; latticeai/api/workspace.py:617). None of these get ingestion_provenance rows, SOURCE nodes, or pre/post_tool hooks. The server_app.py:333 comment admits it: 'Existing direct ingest callers keep working; new paths converge here.' Only browser/web/text ingestion (latticeai/api/browser.py) actually flows through the pipeline, so the docs/kg-schema.md claim that every content node can 'always explain its origin' is false for the majority of real write traffic.

problems.title: docs/kg-schema.md documents APIs and guarantees that do not exist
problems.detail: Line 81 claims '엔드포인트 룰은 코드에서 강제된다 (validate_endpoints in kg_schema.py)' — validate_endpoints exists nowhere in the repo (grep confirms zero hits); no endpoint-pair validation is enforced anywhere. Lines 199-265 document a 'migrate' CLI subcommand, Node/Edge dataclasses, KGStoreV2.upsert_node/upsert_edge/neighbors/search_similar — all removed (kg_schema.py's own NOTE at lines 488-493 says so). The doc also says embeddings default to 1024-d sentence-transformers via llm_router while the actual default embedder is a 384-d hash model (local_embeddings.py:21-22) and EMBED_DIM=1024 in kg_schema.py:56 vs DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_DIM=384 are two unreconciled constants. The schema doc is the product's spec surface and it actively misleads.

problems.title: Default search quality is demo-grade: hash embeddings + brute-force scan + LIKE keyword matching
problems.detail: Out of the box the embedder is the deterministic feature-hashing model (grade='fallback'), so 'vector search' is token-hash overlap, not semantics. vector_search decodes up to 10,000 embedding BLOBs and computes cosine in pure Python per query (knowledge_graph.py:4306-4332) — no sqlite-vec/ANN despite docs promising it ('sqlite-vec 가 설치되면 인덱스 자동 활용 (추후)'). Keyword search is `title LIKE '%q%' OR summary LIKE ... OR metadata_json LIKE ...` (lines 3738-3747) with no FTS5, meaning full table scans and substring matches against raw JSON. This stack will not scale past a few tens of thousands of nodes and gives weak relevance — a core gap for a 'Digital Brain' whose primary read operation is recall.

problems.title: graph_curator.py is dead code in production
problems.detail: Outside its own file and tests/unit/test_graph_curator.py, graph_curator is referenced only by scripts/generate_diagrams.py (a diagram label). auto_build_graph_overlay, curate_nodes, alias clustering, secret masking, and importance decay are never invoked by ingestion, the graph API, or the curated graph view — knowledge_graph.py reimplements weaker versions of the same ideas (_topic_candidates, _extract_concepts_rules, importance scoring inside graph()). The module that solves the product's stated noise problem (too many junk nodes, no aliasing, no decay) is shipped but unwired, and its importance/decay outputs are exactly what the empty nodes_v2.importance_score/last_used columns need.

problems.title: No workspace/owner scoping on graph reads — one global brain for all authenticated users
problems.detail: latticeai/api/search.py only does require_user(request); search(), graph(), traverse(), vector_search() have no owner/workspace filter. workspace_id and owner exist only inside metadata_json blobs (ingest_source node_meta, knowledge_graph.py:3009-3021) and in provenance rows — never as queryable node columns, never enforced. nodes_v2 has owner_id/visibility columns that would support this but they are hardwired to NULL/'private'. Any authenticated user retrieves any other user's/workspace's ingested knowledge, contradicting both the v1.1.0 workspace-scoping work and the privacy-first positioning.

problems.title: No temporal/episodic dimension: edge identity erases history, and there is no memory-type model
problems.detail: Edges are UNIQUE(from_node, to_node, type) with weight=max(old,new) on conflict (knowledge_graph.py:1287-1299), so repeated observations of a relationship collapse into one row — when something was learned, how often, and whether it still holds are unrecoverable. Nodes have only created_at/updated_at; no observed_at/valid_from/valid_until, no superseded_by. The taxonomy has DECISION/TASK/EVENT nodes but no EXPERIENCE, no episodic-vs-semantic distinction, no consolidation. MemoryService (latticeai/services/memory_service.py) is a read-only façade over six unrelated stores — it reports tiers but defines no memory data model. A Digital Brain that cannot distinguish 'what happened' from 'what is true' and cannot revise beliefs (CONTRADICTS exists as an enum but nothing produces or resolves it) is a document index, not a memory.

problems.title: Write path still mints Korean free-string edge types, perpetuating the legacy taxonomy forever
problems.detail: ingest_source/ingest_document write new edges as '업로드함', '언급함', '포함함' (knowledge_graph.py:3045,3050,3061,3070,3084) and node types as capitalized free strings ('Document', 'Chunk', 'Source'). Every new write re-creates the legacy debt that from_legacy() then normalizes in the projection; the canonical enums are never the source of truth at write time, so the legacy_type column and the dual mapping tables can never be retired.

problems.title: Conversation history is capped at 50 entries in a JSON file — directly contradicts 'knowledge is durable'
problems.detail: save_to_history truncates chat_history.json to the last 50 items (latticeai/server_app.py, history[-50:] near line 664). Graph nodes from ingest_message survive, but the authoritative conversation record (the MemoryService 'conversation' tier reads this same file) silently discards everything older. Raw episodic data — the most valuable input for a future memory-consolidation pipeline — is being thrown away by design.

problems.title: Projection-version bumps trigger full delete-and-rebuild of v2 at startup
problems.detail: Any _PROJECTION_VERSION change (currently 4, knowledge_graph.py:44) drops and re-projects every node and edge inside one startup transaction (lines 1039-1049, 1101-1118). Fine at thousands of rows; at the multi-hundred-thousand-node scale a Digital Brain implies, this is unbounded startup latency with WAL growth, and there is no incremental migration path.

problems.title: LLM extraction runs synchronously inside the ingest transaction with awkward event-loop bridging
problems.detail: _llm_extract_concepts/_llm_extract_triples (knowledge_graph.py:421-491) spawn a ThreadPoolExecutor running asyncio.run with a 30s timeout, called from within ingest paths that hold a SQLite write connection. Per-ingest blocking LLM calls (up to 2x30s) on the request path, with silent fallback to regex rules on any failure — extraction quality is non-deterministic and unobservable (only a debug log distinguishes LLM-graded from rule-graded triples; the resulting nodes are indistinguishable since created_by is never recorded).

opportunities.title: Promote v2 to the single authoritative store and retire the legacy tables
opportunities.detail: Invert the current arrangement: write canonical NodeType/EdgeType enums natively to nodes_v2/edges_v2 at every call site (no more Korean verb strings), make all reads query v2's normalized type column directly, generate legacy-shaped compatibility views only if old API consumers need them, and delete nodes/edges + the kgv2_* reconstruction views after one migration release. This finally activates owner_id, visibility, importance_score, and per-edge evidence/confidence/created_by as live data instead of defaults, and removes the dual-write invariant machinery (_v2_sync_report, byte-faithful projection contracts) that exists only to police the split-brain.

opportunities.title: Add a first-class memory model: episodic / semantic / procedural layers over the graph
opportunities.detail: Introduce MEMORY-layer entities the Digital Brain needs: EXPERIENCE/EPISODE nodes (immutable, timestamped records of conversations, tool runs, decisions-in-context, with observed_at and full provenance), SEMANTIC facts (consolidated, confidence-scored claims with evidence edges back to the episodes that support them, plus valid_from/superseded_by for belief revision via the existing CONTRADICTS/EVOLVES_FROM edge types), and CONTEXT/DECISION records (why something was decided, by whom, alternatives considered). Build a background consolidation job (the 'sleep' phase) that promotes episodic content into semantic nodes using graph_curator's promotion/clustering/decay logic. Replace the 50-entry chat_history.json cap with durable episodic storage in SQLite.

opportunities.title: Route 100% of graph writes through IngestionPipeline and measure provenance coverage
opportunities.detail: Convert upload_service.py, server_app.py save_to_history (chat), api/mcp.py, api/chat.py, and workspace_os.py ingest_event call sites into IngestionItem submissions (add 'chat_message', 'upload', 'workspace_event', 'mcp' to the source-type sets), so every node gets a provenance row, a SOURCE node, and hook coverage. Add a provenance-coverage stat (nodes with provenance / total content nodes) to provenance_stats() and surface it in the KG status UI so regressions are visible. This makes the documented 'every node explains its origin' guarantee actually true.

opportunities.title: Make edge evidence, confidence, and created_by real
opportunities.detail: The triple extractors already produce context snippets and confidence (knowledge_graph.py:480-487) but they are flattened into metadata.context and the v2 projection hardcodes evidence='[]', created_by='legacy'. Thread extractor identity (extractor:llm-<model> vs rule:regex), evidence chunk ids, and confidence into _upsert_edge and the v2 projection; implement the documented-but-missing validate_endpoints to reject nonsensical type pairs. This turns the graph from 'strings that co-occurred' into auditable claims — the prerequisite for trust in an AI memory.

opportunities.title: Upgrade the retrieval stack: FTS5, sqlite-vec/ANN, and a production local embedder by default
opportunities.detail: Add an FTS5 virtual table over node titles/summaries/chunk text to replace LIKE '%q%' scans; integrate sqlite-vec (or a faiss/hnsw sidecar) so vector_search stops decoding 10k blobs in Python per query; make the setup flow provision a real local embedding model (MLX bge-m3 or Ollama nomic-embed-text — profiles already exist in embedding_providers.py) so the hash embedder is genuinely a fallback rather than the de-facto default; reconcile EMBED_DIM (1024) vs DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_DIM (384) into one config source. Hybrid fusion in search_service.py can stay — it is the channels underneath that are weak.

opportunities.title: Enforce owner/workspace scoping in graph reads
opportunities.detail: Once owner_id/visibility on nodes_v2 carry real values (from IngestionItem.owner/workspace_id, which the pipeline already collects), add a workspace_id column or scoping join to every read API (search, vector_search, graph, traverse, relationship_search) keyed off the authenticated principal in latticeai/api/search.py. Private-by-default with explicit shared/public visibility matches both the existing enterprise workspace model and the privacy-first positioning.

opportunities.title: Wire graph_curator into the live pipeline (or delete it)
opportunities.detail: Run auto_build_graph_overlay after ingestion batches to gate Concept/Topic node creation through its promotion rules (min source diversity, alias clustering, secret check) instead of unconditionally upserting every extracted concept; feed curate_nodes' decayed scores into nodes_v2.importance_score/last_used and use them in graph() instead of the ad-hoc per-request importance math at lines 3691-3727. Its mask_secrets should also run on chunk text before storage, not just on curator candidates. If this is not done in v4, delete the module — shipping a solution and not using it is worse than not having it.

opportunities.title: Fix or regenerate docs/kg-schema.md from code
opportunities.detail: Remove the false validate_endpoints claim, the deleted Node/Edge/search_similar/migrate-CLI examples, and the stale embedding-dimension story; generate the type catalog tables directly from the NodeType/EdgeType enums so the doc cannot drift again. For a product whose pitch is 'your knowledge, trustworthy and durable', the schema spec being wrong is a credibility problem out of proportion to its fix cost.

opportunities.title: Version the graph itself for portability evolution
opportunities.detail: kg_portability.py's export header already stamps schema/projection/embed-dim versions; add an importer-side migration registry (format_version 1 → N transforms) and include memory-layer tables in export once they exist, so a v4 brain can always re-import a v3.6 export. Also add export scoping by workspace_id (the parameter is accepted today but unused — export() dumps the entire DB regardless).
